generation.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept.
Edit the first reference sheet into the corrected Flagship_Center concept. Preserve the same AURORA simple faceted cartoon 3D rendering, ivory/navy/cyan/warm-yellow palette, pale neutral background, landscape 3:2 composition, large hero on the left and FRONT / SIDE / TOP supplemental views on the right. This is a FLOATING LUNAR HEAVY SHIPYARD, taking advantage of the Moon's low gravity to assemble a supermassive command carrier.

Reference roles:
1: previous Flagship_Center sheet, edit target. Keep its clean rendering and small support-facility family, but replace the grounded dry-dock architecture and wrong narrow pointed ship.
2: original Iron_Behemoth (深空吞噬者) icon, identity reference for the ship.
3: existing Iron_Behemoth top silhouette: BROAD FRONT, NARROW REAR, triangular mothership body, long paired forward prongs and a narrow rear engine/command spine. Ignore UI and text in this reference.
4: original flagship-center icon: floating open heavy space construction facility; use its suspended structural logic, not its tiny photorealistic detailing.

Main change:
Replace the ground-level U-shaped dock and continuous floor with TWO substantial floating longitudinal service pontoons joined by a raised rear command bridge. Their navy undersides have four clearly readable broad cyan magnetic-lift/hover modules. All of this is visibly OFF the ground with a large clean air gap and a separated soft shadow. No landing legs, ground pillars, ramp to the ground, or hidden solid slab under the vessel. The central assembly volume is OPEN above and below. Two or three chunky yellow articulated assembly manipulators reach inward from the side rails.

Centerpiece:
A very large HALF-BUILT IRON_BEHEMOTH is suspended horizontally in the center, clearly detached from the dock floor because there IS NO dock floor. It occupies about 70% of the central dock length and is considerably wider than the wrong needle-shaped ship in reference 1. Preserve the broad-front tapering triangular identity from references 2 and 3, paired forked forward projections and narrow aft section. Show around half the hull armored in clean white/navy broad plates and half still exposed as large dark keel beams and a FEW chunky structural ribs, open hangar compartments, partially installed engine modules. Make the unfinished state unmistakable through large missing hull sections, not tiny scratched panels. The vessel is a massive COMMAND CARRIER, no giant main cannon or gun turrets. Place one large unfinished hull panel in a manipulator as an obvious assembly action. The half-built ship must remain readable and not be concealed by a roof.

Peripheral facilities:
Retain FOUR small purposeful support pods: component storage with a few large crates, engine-assembly pod holding a big engine module, traffic-control cabin, and repair canopy. Mount them as compact floating side platforms joined to the two main floating pontoons by short rigid service bridges. Each little platform has a visibly functional underside hover unit. Different sizes, subordinate to the main dock, compact arrangement. They do not sit on the ground and are not a ring of identical satellites.

Composition and clarity:
Elevate the hero camera just enough to show BOTH the exposed half-built carrier AND the suspended underside/open central void. The FRONT and SIDE views MUST clearly show an air gap under all dock modules, especially the center opening and vessel underside. TOP must show the ship's broad triangular shape rather than an elongated rocket. Include every support facility consistently.
Render this as a simple clean cartoon game asset with 10–20 large masses and restrained secondary details, not a busy photorealistic shipyard. No terrain, stones, trees, acres of roads, starscape, glowing exhaust plumes or fog. Preserve neutral reference-sheet background; the floating shadows convey levitation. Only text: Flagship_Center, FRONT, SIDE, TOP, and a small label IRON_BEHEMOTH / UNDER CONSTRUCTION near the hero.

correction.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit ONLY the half-built carrier inside reference 1. Preserve the floating lunar shipyard, its open underside with no central floor, all four small peripheral platforms, hovering pads, ivory/navy/yellow palette, clean cartoon rendering, sheet composition and labels EXACTLY. Reference 2 shows the required Iron_Behemoth top silhouette; ignore its UI.

The carrier silhouette in reference 1 is backward: it narrows into a pointed bow. Correct it to the actual Iron_Behemoth identity: a WIDE FRONT at the camera-near end and a NARROW REAR under the far command bridge. A broad, heavy triangular command-carrier hull like an inverted wedge, not a Star Destroyer or a needle-shaped cruiser. In TOP view the FRONT is at the BOTTOM of the panel. The foremost third spans about 80 percent of the empty space between dock rails; the rear third near the command bridge tapers to about 30 percent. The front edge is WIDE and FLAT across, with TWO long thick forward prongs extending from its outer left and right corners, widely separated by the broad front opening. Do not converge the prongs at the center. NO acute central nose. Two broad triangular side shoulders taper INWARD as they go REARWARD toward a narrow engine/command spine at the far bridge end. Refer directly to reference 2: the wide edge with two spread prongs is the front; the thin tip with engines is the rear.

Keep the ship obviously half-built: one large front shoulder has clean ivory armor; the opposite shoulder and rear show about 6–8 broad dark structural ribs and a chunky central keel. Simplify the excessive fine scaffold clutter into bold low-poly beams. No main cannon. Maintain clear air gaps between carrier, dock and ground; the carrier is suspended, no landing feet. The assembly manipulators work on the partly exposed hull.

Make the SAME corrected wide-front/narrow-rear ship in every view. Leave every other building and support platform unchanged.
